summary: Updates a bounded counter stored at this+0xEC by delta a2. On a positive delta, clamps to the last valid index (MenuCursorCount_bc90 result minus one). On a non-positive delta, clamps to zero when the result would go negative. Both paths finish by calling UtilityFunction_bd90 and returning its result.

operations.description: Read the current counter value at this+0xEC into a scratch value before applying the delta.
Branch on whether the delta a2 is greater than zero (increment path).
Increment path: store the new counter value (delta a2 added to the current value) back to this+0xEC.
Query the total scrollable item count via MenuCursorCount_bc90(this) and compute the last valid index as count minus one.
Check whether the incremented counter now exceeds the last valid index.
Clamp the counter at this+0xEC down to the last valid index when it overflows.
Non-positive path: store the new counter value (delta a2 added to the current value) back to this+0xEC.
Check whether the decremented counter went below zero.
Clamp the counter at this+0xEC up to zero when the delta would drive it negative.
Invoke UtilityFunction_bd90(this) after the counter update.
Return the result of UtilityFunction_bd90 on both paths.

unresolved: What the counter at this+0xEC drives (scroll position per existing analysis) is not proven by this function alone; MenuCursorCount_bc90 defines the upper bound semantics.
UtilityFunction_bd90 return value semantics are opaque here.
